newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar jumps to around 116 yen in Tokyo after data.
newsitem.headline: Dollar jumps to around 116 yen in Tokyo after data.

text.p: *Dollar jumped near 116 yen in early Tokyo trade after Japan's June trade surplus data was below earlier market expectations.
*Japan June overall trade surplus stood at 934.21 billion yen, while market had forecast the surplus to total more than 1.0 trillion.
*Active buying by interbank operators boosted greenback briefly above 116 yen, but offers by exporters lined up around 116.20-116.30 yen apparently capped upside.
*Active short-covering of mark against yen also depressed yen sentiment. But offers by German automakers spotted, which limited German currency's gains against yen.
*Mark stood at 64.73/76 yen at 0015 GMT, compared with a 64.50 yen close in New York.

*"The market could be testing the previous New York high of 116.40 yen, but initially bidders are cautious about buying aggressively amid offers by exporters on rallies," a long-term credit bank dealer said.
*Dollar's decisive break above 116.40 yen would likely make upward path to major resistance of 117 yen.
